sources.text: Search this site Embedded Files The Godula Lab at UCSD Chemical glycobiology to understand and control disease processes Welcome to the godula lab Our research program in chemical glycobiology is broadly interested in gaining an understanding of how glycans encode and transmit biological information at the boundary between cells and their environment. To achieve this objective, we develop chemical and materials-based strategies to intercept, analyze and, ultimately, rewrite this information . Our ultimate goal is to explore new avenues for targeting glycans to advance biomedical research and human health. 2025 Lab announcements Welcome, Marc ! Marc Kawada has joined the lab as a Post-doctoral scholar in November 202 5 . Congratulations Dr . Julianna Foll mar on her successful defense and graduation with her PhD! She is starting a Post-doctoral position at Eli Lill y in the fall. Congratulations Yihan on receiving the 2025 SPURS award! Announcement Archive Congratulations Nathan on being awarded the 2024 NSF GRFP Fellowship! Congratulations Sarah on being awarded the Spring 2024 Teaching Assistant Excellence Award! Congratulations Julianna on starting an internship at Eli Lilly and Co. in August! Congratulations Deborah on being awarded the 2024 Charles L. Perrin Summer Research Fellowship! Welcome, Shubham!
